question: Will WTI crude close the week (Friday, August 7) above $80?

model.prompt_context: Resolves YES if the official daily settlement price of WTI Crude Oil Futures for August 7, 2026, as published by CME Group (cmegroup.com), is strictly greater than $80.00 per barrel. A settlement price of exactly $80.00 or below resolves NO.

data_sources: Investing.com – Crude Oil WTI Futures Historical Data (investing.com/commodities/crude-oil-historical-data)
CME Group – WTI Crude Oil Futures Settlements
